reply.shortGloss: to close; to shut; to turn off
reply.emotion: firm and decisive, finishing a task
notes: Cerrar is a stem-changing verb (e > ie), so it becomes cierro, cierras, cierra in the present tense.
Do not confuse cerrar (to close) with cerca (near).

senses.definition: Poner algo de modo que no esté abierto, impidiendo el paso o la entrada.

examples.text: Voy a cerrar la ventana porque hace frío.
examples.translation: I am going to close the window because it is cold.
examples.emotion: practical and purposeful, taking care of the room

senses.definition: Interrumpir el paso de la luz, el agua o el gas mediante una llave o un interruptor.

examples.text: No olvides cerrar la llave del agua.
examples.translation: Don't forget to turn off the water faucet.
examples.emotion: remindful and careful, giving a helpful piece of advice
